notes: The Monday to Friday Mass card now shows times like 8:30am - 9:00am, with Day, Time and Venue headings. The priest and founder can set the estimated end time.
new: Each Mass now shows an estimated end time, for example 8:30am - 9:00am. If no end time is set, it is 30 minutes after the start.
The priest and founder can set the end time for each weekday in Edit weekly schedule.
changed: Times now show as am or pm, like 8:30am.
The weekly table has Day, Time and Venue headings.
Today's Mass stays on the card until its end time, then the card moves on to the next Mass.
